description: Section templates for specialist-type visit summary generation (drives F5 Summary Generator)

first_visit.description: Comprehensive template for initial cardiology consultation, covering all cardiovascular risk factors

sections.title: Active Conditions & Diagnoses
sections.instructions: List all active chronic conditions with ICD-10 codes where available. Flag conditions with high cardiovascular relevance.

sections.title: Current Medications
sections.instructions: List medications with dose and frequency. Flag cardiovascular medications (statins, beta-blockers, ACEi/ARBs, antiplatelet agents, anticoagulants).

sections.title: Blood Pressure
sections.instructions: Show all recorded BP readings. Characterize as controlled/uncontrolled per ACC/AHA 2017 guidelines. Trend direction if ≥2 readings.

sections.title: Lipid Panel
sections.instructions: Present most recent complete lipid panel. Calculate 10-year ASCVD risk if first visit data available. Flag LDL relative to risk-stratified target.

sections.title: Glucose Metabolism
sections.instructions: Present HbA1c and/or fasting glucose. Characterize glycemic control per ADA targets if diabetes is present.

sections.title: Inflammatory Markers
sections.instructions: Include hsCRP if available. Classify as low/average/high cardiovascular risk per ACC/AHA thresholds.

sections.title: Renal Function
sections.instructions: Present eGFR and ACR. Classify CKD stage per KDIGO if abnormal. Note CKD significantly elevates cardiovascular risk.

sections.title: Notable Trends
sections.instructions: Identify biomarkers with meaningful directional change over the available time period. Limit to the 3 most clinically significant trends. Do not extrapolate or predict.

sections.title: Data Gaps
sections.instructions: List standard cardiology biomarkers not present in patient records. Separate into: not tested recently (<12 months) vs. never tested.

sections.title: Patient Notes
sections.instructions: Include any free-text annotations the patient has added. Display verbatim, clearly distinguished from system-generated content.

sections.title: Questions for Your Doctor
sections.instructions: Patient-supplied questions only. Do not generate questions from clinical data.

sections.title: Disclaimer
sections.instructions: Always include the standard Vitalog disclaimer. This section is appended automatically and cannot be omitted.
sections.fixed_content: This summary was generated by Vitalog from your personal health records for informational purposes only. It is not a medical diagnosis, clinical assessment, or treatment recommendation. All values shown are drawn directly from your uploaded lab reports and have not been independently verified by a clinician. Please review this information with your healthcare provider before making any health decisions.

follow_up.description: Focused template for cardiology follow-up emphasizing interval changes

sections.title: Changes Since Last Visit
sections.instructions: Highlight biomarker values that changed since the previous summary date. Focus on direction and magnitude.

sections.title: Blood Pressure
sections.instructions: Show BP trend for the interval period.

sections.title: Lipid Panel
sections.instructions: Compare most recent lipid panel to previous. Note statin adherence context if medication data available.

sections.title: Glucose Metabolism
sections.instructions: HbA1c interval change if T2D is an active condition.

sections.title: Renal Function
sections.instructions: eGFR and ACR with direction of change.

sections.title: Data Gaps
sections.instructions: Standard cardiology labs not present in the interval.

sections.title: Disclaimer
sections.instructions: Standard Vitalog disclaimer — always appended.
sections.fixed_content: This summary was generated by Vitalog from your personal health records for informational purposes only. It is not a medical diagnosis, clinical assessment, or treatment recommendation. All values shown are drawn directly from your uploaded lab reports and have not been independently verified by a clinician. Please review this information with your healthcare provider before making any health decisions.

first_visit.description: Template for initial endocrinology consultation, primarily T2D and thyroid

sections.title: Active Conditions & Diagnoses
sections.instructions: List all active conditions. Highlight endocrine conditions (diabetes, thyroid disease, metabolic syndrome).

sections.title: Current Medications
sections.instructions: List all medications, highlight diabetes and thyroid medications.

sections.title: Glycemic Control
sections.instructions: Full glucose history: HbA1c trend (all available data points), fasting glucose, postprandial glucose. Classify control per ADA standards.

sections.title: Thyroid Function
sections.instructions: TSH and Free T4 values. Characterize thyroid status. Note treatment dose if on thyroid replacement.

sections.title: Metabolic Panel
sections.instructions: Lipids, liver enzymes, renal function for complete metabolic picture.

sections.title: Nutritional Markers
sections.instructions: Vitamin D, B12, ferritin if available. B12 particularly important in metformin users.

sections.title: Data Gaps
sections.instructions: Standard endocrinology labs not present in records.

sections.title: Disclaimer
sections.instructions: Standard Vitalog disclaimer.
sections.fixed_content: This summary was generated by Vitalog from your personal health records for informational purposes only. It is not a medical diagnosis, clinical assessment, or treatment recommendation. All values shown are drawn directly from your uploaded lab reports and have not been independently verified by a clinician. Please review this information with your healthcare provider before making any health decisions.

first_visit.description: Template for initial nephrology consultation focused on CKD staging and progression

sections.title: Active Conditions & Diagnoses
sections.instructions: Highlight conditions affecting kidney function (T2D, HTN, CKD).

sections.title: Kidney Function
sections.instructions: eGFR and ACR history. Classify CKD stage (G1-G5 × A1-A3). Show trend direction.

sections.title: Electrolytes
sections.instructions: Sodium, potassium, chloride panel. Flag abnormal values.

sections.title: Anemia of CKD
sections.instructions: Hemoglobin, ferritin. Anemia of CKD typically normocytic.

sections.title: Glycemic Control & Blood Pressure
sections.instructions: Key modifiable CKD progression factors.

sections.title: Disclaimer
sections.instructions: Standard Vitalog disclaimer.
